messages.subject: Testing for dif
parts:
Hi Phil, 

I am attempting to test for differences in slopes in a graded response model based on differences in the traditional difficulty parameters (ie. b1, b2, b3, b4, rather than d1, d2, d3, d4).  I know that to do so, I need to set up my test to constrain both the slope (ie. a1) and the appropriate d parameter to be equal across the groups.  However, what value of d1 to d4 should I constrain?  For example, if I want to test for DIF for the b1 parameter, do I then constrain a1 and d1 to be equal or do I constrain a1 and d4 to be equal.

As always thanks, 

Cathy

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Testing for dif
parts:
Hi Cathy,

Each a1-d# combo can be used to translate to the associate b# difficulty, so if you're looking to test the difficulty parameter of the first difficulty b1 then constraining a1 and d1 would do it.

Phil
